lessons_used: Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted functional hints (photo quality, path helper, account security), select clean layouts (card carousel, single-click identity), key desktop flows (summon, visibility/control), and specific hotkey copy produced significant wins.

Harmful changes: Major structural overhauls (docking setup flow, split personality redesign), spotlight and split view layouts, account persistence hints, and certain copy changes caused severe performance drops or early test cutoffs.
No effect seen: Wait time, progress, and status indicators, background notifications, desktop prep or tutorial screens, and incentive badges repeatedly showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: High predictions (+8.0% or above) consistently overestimated actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or negative performance drops.

Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially desktop visibility/control flows, shortcut hotkey copy, summon flows, security hints, and story reordering—far exceeded low or negative predictions.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Carousel Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection interface to use a carousel layout with detailed companion trait cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest funnel conversion (64.2%). A carousel layout lets users browse options more visually and fluidly.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection layout to a carousel retains the ability to choose a pet within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high dropoff, but adoption redesigns are historically harmful (-13.1%).

candidates.title: Companion Desktop Interaction Intro Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new screen at the end of onboarding explaining how to click, control, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support tickets show user confusion after onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.

new_companion_interaction_intro.headline: Interacting with Your Desktop Pet
new_companion_interaction_intro.body: Click your pet on the desktop at any time to open its context menu, send it away, or start chatting.

guard.reason: Adding an interaction guide screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Support mail points to issue, but tutorial/intro screens consistently show no effect or negative impact.

candidates.title: Account Identity Pet Restore Assurance Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing into an existing account recovers previous pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with existing accounts.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with an existing account automatically restores all your previously saved pets and customization.

guard.reason: Adding an informational hint to the sign-in screen is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Account persistence hints were explicitly flagged as harmful changes in previous lessons.

candidates.title: Sign-In Before Pick Friend Sequence Reorder
candidates.change: Reorders the sequence so sign-in occurs immediately before picking a friend.
candidates.why: Ensures user accounts and pet recovery identity are established before custom pet selection occurs.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in before pick_friend while keeping all required steps is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Flow reorderings produce significant wins, with sign_in reordering averaging +1.9% historical lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Audio and Vocal Pet Feedback Flow
candidates.change: Adds a new audio feedback flow at the end of onboarding for users to preview sound cues and pet responses.
candidates.why: Introduces users to interactive desktop audio features early, addressing post-onboarding engagement drop-offs.

new_pet_audio_setup.headline: Pet Voice and Sound Cues
new_pet_audio_setup.body: Preview companion audio cues and enable voice responses for desktop interactions.

guard.reason: Adding a pet audio setup screen following home_intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Desktop flows yield slight wins (+0.9%), though creating a new flow requires custom development.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Visibility Quick Hint Copy
candidates.change: Updates the waiting screen body text to clearly explain where and when the pet will show up on the main screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported that pets do not show up on the desktop or users cannot find them.

waiting.body: Your pet is rendering and will automatically appear in the corner of your main screen once ready.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen copy maintains its job of indicating the pet is being created.

candidates.score_note: Desktop visibility copy updates are proven winning changes supported by user tickets.

candidates.title: Choose Path Checklist Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a clear checklist layout comparing quick preset pets vs custom creation.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean time (514s); a checklist format clarifies option differences to speed up decisions.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path into a checklist while keeping both preset adopt and custom pet paths is valid.

candidates.score_note: Targets high mean time; path selection redesigns historically produce mild positive lift (+0.5%).

candidates.title: Custom Photo Background Lighting Hint
candidates.change: Adds a photo quality hint on the photo upload screen advising users to pick bright, well-lit photos.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or generating unexpected visual glitches.

upload_photos.hint: For optimal pet rendering quality, choose well-lit photos with clear facial features.

guard.reason: Adding a photo quality hint on the photo upload screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the highest dropoff step (adoption) using targeted photo quality hints, a proven win.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Summon Shortcut Intro Screen
candidates.change: Adds a screen right before completion introducing primary hotkeys for summoning and hiding the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support complaints indicate users don't know how to hide or summon their companion after setup.

new_desktop_summon_guide.headline: Quick Pet Control Hotkeys
new_desktop_summon_guide.body: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a hotkey control guide screen inside onboarding prior to home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Intro/tutorial screens in home step consistently perform poorly (-3.2% historical change).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Incentive
candidates.change: Adds an official companion mascot badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption is the major friction point (64.2%); adding visual rewards boosts completion sentiment.

guard.reason: Replacing the official adoption stamp with a playful badge fails to maintain the official stamp requirement.
